paite: Huan, Sinar kho kumpipa Amraphelte, Ellasar kho kumpipa Ariokte, Elam kho kumpipa Kedorlamomerte, Goiim kho kumpipa Tidalte dam laiin hichi ahia.
english: It happened in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,

paite: Amau bel Sodom kho kumpipa Bera a sim uh. Gomorra kho kumpipa Birsate, Admah kho kumpipa Sinabte, Zeboiim kho kumpipate Smeberte, Bela kho kumpipate leng a sim ua, (huai tuh Zoar ahi).
english: that they made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).

paite: Huan hiai tengteng Siddim guam ah a pang ua, (huai guam Tuipi Al ahita).
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).

paite: Kum sawm leh kum nih singin Kedorlaomer nuaiah a om ua, a kum sawm leh kum thumna ah a helta uh.
english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year, they rebelled.

paite: Huchiin, a kum sawm leh kum lina ah Kedorlaomer leh a kianga kumpipa omte a hong ua, Asteroth-karnaim khua ah Rephaimte a that ua, ham khua ah Zusimte a that ua, Kariathaim jangah Emimte a that ua,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

paite: A omna Seir tangah Elparan phain, Horte a that ua, (El-paran gamdei juala om ahi).
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to Elparan, which is by the wilderness.

paite: Huan, a kik nawn ua, Enmispet a tungua (huai Kades ahita), Amelekte gam a mi teng leh, Amorte, Hazazontamar khua a omte leng, a that nawn uh.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (the same is Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

paite: Huchiin, Sodom kho kumpipate, Gomorra kho kumpipate, Adma kho kumpipate, Zeboiim kho kumpipate, Bela kho kumpipate a pawt ua, (Bela khua Zoar khua ahita); huan, Siddim guam ah amau sual dingin a pangta uhi.
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim;

paite: Elam kho kumpipa Kedorlaomerte, Goiim kho kumpipa Tidalte, Sinar kho kumpipate Amraphelte, Ellasa kho kumpipa Ariokte sual dingin; kumpipa li in kumpipate nga a sual uh.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

paite: Huan, Siddim guam longnai khukin a dim a; huan, Sodom leh Gomorra kho kumpipate a taikek ua, huai laiah a kia ua, ke valte tang ah a tai touta uhi.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and those who remained fled to the hills.

paite: Huchiin, Sodom leh Gomorra mite sum tengteng leh a nek ding tengteng uh a la ua, a paita uh.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

paite: Lota, Abram unau tapa, /Sodom khua a om, a sumte toh a la ua, a paita uhi.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

paite: Huan, mi khat taikhia a hongpaia, Hebru mi Abram a hilha; amah bel Amor mi Mamre tosaw kiang khawngah a om. Mamre Eskol unau leh Aner unau ahia; huai mite Abramte toh pangkhawm ahi uh.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. Now he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were allies of Abram.

paite: Huan, Abramin a ta salin a pi uh chih a jak takin, a inna piang, amah mi, chilsiamsa, za thum leh sawm leh giat a pi khia a, Dan kho phain a delhta.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.

paite: Huan, jan in amau sual dingin amah leh a sikhate a kihawmjak ua, (Hoba Damaska kho mallamah a om).
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

paite: Huan, sum tengteng a honla kik nawn vek a, a ta Lota leh a sum tengteng a honla kik nawn veka, numeite leng a honpi nawna mi dang tengteng toh
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

paite: Huan, Kedorlaomer leh a kianga kumpipa omte that a pai nungin Sodom kumpipa Save guamah Abram dawnin a hoh suka, (Save guam kumpipa guam a hita).
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

paite: Huan, Salem kho kumpipa Melkisedekin tanghou leh uain a honla a; amah bel Pathian Tungnungpen siampu ahi.:
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.

paite: Huan, aman Abram a vualjawla. Lei leh van neipa, Pathian Tungnungpen Abram vualjawlin omhen:
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:

paite: Na melmate na khuta honpepa, Pathian Tungnungpen, phatin om hen, achia. Huan, Abramin amah bangkim sawm a khat a pia hi.
english: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

paite: Huan, Sodom kho kumpipan Abram kiangah, mite honpia inla, sumte jaw nang kineih maiin, a chi.
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods to yourself.”

paite: Huan, Abramin, Sodom kumpipa kiangah, lei leh van neipa, Toupa, Pathian Tungnungpen lamah ka khut ka jakta hi.
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

paite: Khauzang khat kia leng, khedap khau khat kia leng, na neih himhim kala kei ding, huchilouinjaw, Abram jaw kei hauhsak ahi, na chi kha ding:Tangvalte nek mang leh, ka mi paipihte tantuan kia loujaw kala kei ding; Anerte, Eskolte, Mamreten a tantuan uh la uhen, a chi hi.
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

paite: Tangvalte nek mang leh, ka mi paipihte tantuan kia loujaw kala kei ding; Anerte, Eskolte, Mamreten a tantuan uh la uhen, a chi hi.
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
